title: The bus to school
intro: Every morning at seven a yellow bus takes Sara and her friend Leila to school through the Tehran traffic. Today the two girls chat and laugh so much that Sara forgets something important on the bus. The story practises getting on and off (سوار شدن، پیاده شدن), the present tense with 'they' (حرف می‌زنند، می‌خندند) and the negative ندارد, and ends with a kind and funny bus driver.
source: An original story for this course.

sentences.en: It is seven o'clock in the morning.

sentences.fa: سارا با کیفش جلوی در خانه منتظر است.
sentences.r: Sārā bā kif-ash jelo-ye dar-e khāne montazer ast.
sentences.en: Sara is waiting with her bag in front of the door of the house.
sentences.faV: سارا با کیفَش جِلویِ دَرِ خانه مُنتَظِر اَست.

sentences.fa: سارا سوار می‌شود و کنار لیلا می‌نشیند.
sentences.r: Sārā savār mi-shavad o kenār-e Leylā mi-neshinad.
sentences.en: Sara gets on and sits next to Leila.
sentences.faV: سارا سَوار می‌شَوَد و کِنارِ لَیلا می‌نِشینَد.

sentences.fa: دو دوست حرف می‌زنند و می‌خندند.
sentences.r: do dust harf mi-zanand o mi-khandand.
sentences.en: The two friends talk and laugh.
sentences.faV: دو دوست حَرف می‌زَنَند و می‌خَندَند.

sentences.fa: اما کیف سارا در اتوبوس است!
sentences.r: ammā kif-e Sārā dar otobus ast!
sentences.en: But Sara's bag is on the bus!
sentences.faV: اَمّا کیفِ سارا دَر اُتوبوس اَست!

sentences.fa: در کلاس، سارا کتاب ندارد و دفتر ندارد.
sentences.r: dar kelās, Sārā ketāb na-dārad o daftar na-dārad.
sentences.en: In class, Sara has no book and no notebook.
sentences.faV: دَر کِلاس، سارا کِتاب نَدارَد و دَفتَر نَدارَد.

sentences.en: Suddenly someone knocks at the door.

sentences.fa: راننده‌ی اتوبوس با کیف سارا پشت در است!
sentences.r: rānande-ye otobus bā kif-e Sārā posht-e dar ast!
sentences.en: The bus driver is at the door with Sara's bag!
sentences.faV: رانَنده‌یِ اُتوبوس با کیفِ سارا پُشتِ دَر اَست!

sentences.fa: راننده می‌خندد و می‌گوید: «سارا خانم، کیف تو هم می‌خواهد به مدرسه بیاید!»
sentences.r: rānande mi-khandad o mi-guyad: «Sārā khānom, kif-e to ham mi-khāhad be madrese bi-yāyad!»
sentences.en: The driver laughs and says: "Miss Sara, your bag wants to come to school too!"
sentences.faV: رانَنده می‌خَندَد و می‌گویَد: «سارا خانُم، کیفِ تو هَم می‌خواهَد به مَدرِسه بیایَد!»

vocab.en: behind (posht-e dar: at the door, outside it)

questions.q: What colour is the school bus?
Who does Sara sit next to?
What does Sara forget on the bus?
Who brings Sara's bag to school?

after: Persian gets on and off with two compound verbs: سوار شدن 'to become a rider' (get on a bus, get into a car, mount a horse) and پیاده شدن 'to become a walker' (get off, get out). You will hear the second one at every bus stop and in every taxi. در زدن 'to knock' is literally 'to hit the door'. The driver's سارا خانم 'Miss Sara' is a playful way adults talk to a little girl – خانم after a first name is polite and warm, just like آقا for a boy: امیر آقا. And notice his joke: کیف تو هم می‌خواهد به مدرسه بیاید – after می‌خواهد 'wants', the second verb is in the subjunctive, بیاید '(that) it comes'.
